entries.reason: Fix blocked by upstream pins, not reachable here (ADR-0187 decision 160). fsspec 2025.3.0 is held by datasets 3.6.0 (fsspec<=2025.3.0, and every datasets 3.x caps it at or below that), which garak 0.17.0 requires (datasets<4.0); installing 2026.6.0 breaks the declared constraints and the build's pip check. The flaw is code execution when fsspec loads a crafted reference document. In this image fsspec is reached only through datasets and the Hugging Face hub client, which garak calls from packagehallucination and sysprompt_extraction (planned since 2026-10-10, ADR-0187 decision 201), audio and goat (never planned). Since the pre-seed (decisions 198-200) those calls read ONLY the image's own read-only Hub cache: the pinned package-list and system-prompt datasets (TSV, JSON Lines and JSON files, each pinned by sha256 at build, no reference documents) materialised at build time, loaded with HF_HUB_OFFLINE/HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE set and no route out. The worker reaches only the gateway, and no file or URL a run supplies reaches fsspec (garak reads its bundled data by path; our config names no URL but the gateway and fixes the dataset ids). Re-check at each garak release (about monthly).
